chapter: Other bands: Royal Jazz, H&J, Rainbow Room
title: Playing clarinet for hospital patients during appendix surgery
summary: At Charity Hospital for an appendix operation he entertained staff and patients on the clarinet, years before joining Celestin.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: That just about finishes up this reel of tape if there's anything else that you want to add. I think you've covered your life pretty well.

Is there anything else in particular that you've been in the band? Well, I can say, well, not, I can't think of nothing about the band now, but I've taken sick. I had to go to the hospital to get operated on for clinics. Well, I had been playing my horn for a few years then. So, the doctors and nurses heard that I played music. So they wanted me to play with them some numbers. So, my mother, when she came to see me at the hospital, she brought the client up there. And I played a few. Yeah, I entertained the patients, the nurses and the doctors at the charity hospital. At the charity hospital. As well. Yeah. I really enjoyed it. So, the light blowing all right then? Yeah. When about was that, you say? Well, oh gee. Before you joined Salis Band? Oh, way before, yes. Yeah, I was playing with these other little bands then. Because I might have been playing about eight or ten years then. Whenever I'm taking my appendix. So, I really enjoyed it. I really enjoyed playing for them, you know.
